name: dataset/admin.py
summary: Django admin configuration module for the dataset application
purpose: Enables management of dataset application models through Django's built-in administrative interface by registering models and optionally customizing their admin presentation and behavior
responsibilities: Register dataset models with the Django admin site
Define and configure ModelAdmin classes for admin UI customization
Specify admin-visible fields, filters, search behavior, and permissions
Control which dataset models are exposed to administrative users
inputs: Dataset model classes from the dataset app
outputs: Registered admin interfaces for dataset models
Customized admin site behavior and presentation rules
architecture_notes: Follows Django's convention-over-configuration app structure by colocating admin registrations within the app. This module acts as a thin integration layer with Django's admin framework, leveraging its built-in CRUD capabilities to avoid custom internal management views. If the file contains only imports with no registrations, it may be an unused placeholder that should be cleaned up.
improvements: Explicitly register models with tailored ModelAdmin classes rather than relying on default bare registrations
Remove the file if no admin functionality is required to reduce maintenance overhead and attack surface
Configure readonly_fields and granular permissions for sensitive or immutable dataset attributes
Optimize list_display queries using list_select_related or prefetch_related to prevent N+1 issues in the admin list view
Add custom admin actions for bulk dataset operations such as export, validation, or reprocessing
